outcomes.atlas: {{#if (or (gt (count (createColumnOutputs param step.field)) 1) (eq param.string_operation "split"))}}Columns {{quotedNames (createColumnOutputs param step.field)}} are created from the parts of the split source value.{{else if (and (or (eq param.value_mode "Static value") (blank param.value_mode)) (blank param.static_value))}}Column {{quote (orEmpty param.column_name step.field)}} is added to the {{record}} for later logic steps to populate.{{else}}Column {{quote (orEmpty param.column_name step.field)}} is created and populated as defined in this step.{{/if}}
outcomes.source: {{#if (or (gt (count (createColumnOutputs param step.field)) 1) (eq param.string_operation "split"))}}Each of columns {{quotedNames (createColumnOutputs param step.field)}} holds the matching part of the source value, and parts that do not exist are blank.{{else if (and (or (eq param.value_mode "Static value") (blank param.value_mode)) (blank param.static_value))}}Column {{quote (orEmpty param.column_name step.field)}} is present in the output.{{else}}Values in column {{quote (orEmpty param.column_name step.field)}} reconcile to the source fields and rule in this step.{{/if}}
